name: Danganronpa: LIVe or Die - Synthetic Love
source: [spoiler]After surviving the killing game, Daichi has nowhere to go. He decides to find the original Haruo that he knows survived his past game. He gets his address from Gumi and pays him a visit. However, the original Haruo has heavy mental problems originating from his game, where he watched the original Daichi die, and where he caused the deaths of multiple other participants. His trauma had already destroyed his previous relationship. Will he and Daichi finally be able to find happiness?[/spoiler]
